name: i9_7a_top_floor_task_schedule_and_admission
note: Stock Top Floor entry, special-mode admission refusal for a fresh unranked player, and real schedule/help UI. No rank/challenge state is fabricated. Positive battle/economy/recovery is separate real-PG evidence; this scenario does not claim a positive special-mode client battle. The supplied asset does not expose schedule_btn as a visible tappable node; invoke its unchanged stock model callback and open the stock schedule window, without editing client code or inventing schedule data. This proves controller/render consumption, not physical button reachability.
steps: lua:local w=xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('arena') local b=w.scheduleBtn print('vc-task-schedule-button', b:isVisible(), b:getName()) w.arena_:loadModeSchedule(function(infos) xyd.WindowManager.get():openWindow('arena_mode_schedule',{infos=infos}) end)

lua:local w=xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('arena_mode_schedule') assert(w, 'vc-task-schedule-window-missing') assert(#w.scheduleinfos==2, 'vc-task-current-next-schedule-missing') assert(w.scheduleinfos[1].mode>=1 and w.scheduleinfos[1].mode<=6, 'vc-task-invalid-mode') assert(w:nodeByName('bg_tip'):isVisible(), 'vc-task-admission-tip-missing')
